import numpy as np
d=384; H=6; hd=64
def head(l,j):

    g=W[f'ln1_w.{l}']
    Q=W[f'W_q.{l}'][s]*g; K=W[f'W_k.{l}'][s]*g; V=W[f'W_v.{l}'][s]*g; O=W[f'W_o.{l}'][:,s]
    return Q,K,V,O

    idx=np.argsort(-np.abs(e))[:k]
